research.facts:
LIV Golf Secures Enough Player Support for 2027
**Sources consulted:** Golf Magic, ESPN Golf, Golf.com
**Key verified facts:**
- LIV filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy on September 8, 2026 in NJ court [HIGH]
- BC Partners restructuring deal: $300 million total ($127.5M loan + $147.5M senior preferred equity + $25M convertible preferred) [HIGH]
- Player commitment threshold: 50% of players by claim count AND two-thirds of total claim value [HIGH]
- Deadline: October 13, 2026 (35 days from filing) [HIGH]
- Reports indicate LIV is "comfortably above" the player-count threshold [MEDIUM — one source]
- Jon Rahm, Bryson DeChambeau, Dustin Johnson listed as creditors owed $18.7M combined [HIGH]
- Players would hold majority ownership (BC Partners up to 45%) [HIGH]
- LIV 2.0 plans: 10 events in 2027, greater player equity, commercial freedom [MEDIUM]

research.facts:
Youmin Hwang Wins LOTTE Championship
**Sources consulted:** Arab News, Golf Channel, LPGA Tour, ThGolfNewsNet
**Key verified facts:**
- Winner: Youmin Hwang (South Korea, age 22) [HIGH]
- Tournament: 2026 LOTTE Championship at Hoakalei Country Club, Ewa Beach, Hawaii [HIGH]
- Final score: 17-under 271 [HIGH]
- Final round: 5-under 67 [HIGH]
- Margin: Won by one stroke over Hyo Joo Kim (16-under) [HIGH]
- Key moment: Birdied five of last six holes, including final four consecutive [HIGH]
- Runner-up: Hyo Joo Kim [HIGH]
- Defending champion status: Hwang competed on a sponsor exemption [HIGH]
- Minami Katsu (Japan) T3 at 15-under [HIGH]
- Nelly Korda tied fourth [HIGH]
- This is Hwang's first LPGA Tour title [HIGH]
- Purse: $3 million [MEDIUM — confirm]
- Jeeno Thitikul led entering final round at 17-under (from Oct 4 pipeline) [HIGH]
**Note:** Do NOT credit the tournament win to Thitikul — Hwang won. Oct 4 pipeline previewed Thitikul as the leader, but Hwang came from two shots back (was at 15-under per Oct 4 data) to win.
